notes.title: Hello World!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I'm Tiago, and I'm thrilled to introduce our team, Monty&Ducksy, working on our exciting first game, 'DREAM SURVIVOR

We're working on our first game, 'DREAM SURVIVOR,' after taking some time to think about it and learning how to work together as a team.

Stay tuned and share your thoughts with us! What features are you most excited about in 'DREAM SURVIVOR'? We can't wait to hear from you and incorporate your feedback!

Get ready for an exclusive look at the breathtaking concept art next week! We'll be sharing behind-the-scenes insights and sneak peeks of 'DREAM SURVIVOR.

Keep playing, stay tuned, and join us on this incredible journey with 'DREAM SURVIVOR'! Your support means the world to us.
